fair_value.method: Forward P/E: by Sep 2027 the market prices NTM (~FY28) EPS; FY26E ~$8.90 (9M actual $6.87 + ~$2.05 Q4 on 9-11% revenue growth guide), FY27E ~$9.9 (+11%, consensus range ~$9.6-10.7), FY28E ~$10.8 (+9%). $10.8 x 30.5x (a premium to Apple's 25-30x history for the Services mix and 2027 AI/foldable cycle, below today's ~35x forward) = ~$330; cross-check $9.9 FY27 x 33x = $327.

bear.story: Memory '100-year flood' plus supply constraints compress gross margin toward 45-46%; $200-500 iPhone 18 price hikes and a tough comp vs iPhone 17's +22% cause FY27 iPhone decline; Duo is volume-limited; multiple mean-reverts to ~25x on ~$10.2 NTM EPS (Motley Fool-style $240-260 derating), possibly aggravated by Google search-payment appeal risk or a broad tech/AI-sentiment selloff.

base.story: iPhone 18 Pro demand holds (stable lead times on +18% Pro builds), Duo adds ~$14B in the Dec quarter, Services grows ~12-13%, price pass-through offsets most memory inflation; EPS grows ~10%/yr to ~$10.8 NTM; multiple drifts from ~35x to ~32x, so price roughly flat-to-up modestly from $341.

bull.story: Gemini-powered Siri in iOS 27 and the foldable spark an upgrade supercycle; supply constraints ease, memory prices roll over in 2027 and margins rebound to ~48-49%; FY28 EPS ~$11.8 and multiple holds ~37x (consistent with 24/7 bull $436, TD Cowen $400 as the high Street target).

thesis_break_reason: About -24% from $341 and ~25x NTM EPS, the low end of Apple's last-decade multiple band; ordinary 25% vol alone reaches this only ~15-18% of the time, so trading there most likely signals a fundamental problem: a sustained gross-margin reset from memory costs that price increases cannot pass through, an iPhone/Duo demand failure after the price hikes, loss of the ~$20B Google default-search payments, or a China/tariff shock, rather than noise.

key_uncertainties: Depth and duration of the memory-cost spike and how much Apple can pass through in price without hurting units
Whether iPhone 18 Pro + Duo sustain growth against the iPhone 17's +22% comp, given supply constraints on advanced-node SoCs
Multiple sustainability: ~35x forward vs 25x big-tech average and consensus targets (~$328) below the price
Legal: Google default-search payments (DOJ appeal), DOJ monopolization suit, App Store commission rulings
Leadership transition to John Ternus (CEO since 2026-09-01) and AI execution after the Gemini-based Siri launch
reasoning: Evidence: FQ3'26 revenue $109.4B (+16%), iPhone +22%, Mac +29%, Services +12%, EPS $2.02 (+29%, incl. $0.11 tariff refunds); 9M FY26 EPS $6.87. FQ4 guide was softer: revenue +9-11% with 2.5pt FX headwind and worsening supply constraints, GM 47-48% (incl. ~1pt tariff refunds) as memory costs rise ('100-year flood'); Apple raised Mac/iPad and iPhone 18 prices. Since then sentiment turned sharply positive: iOS 27 Gemini-based Siri shipped Sep 14 to good reviews, iPhone Duo announced (pre-orders Oct 16), iPhone 18 Pro lead times stable despite +18% Pro builds (Morgan Stanley) and rising (JPM), stock at records (~$345, ~$5T). Valuation: ~35x forward on ~$9.8 NTM EPS vs consensus targets ~$328 (range ~$215-400) and FY27 EPS ~$9.6-10.7. My fair value ~$330 (30.5x x ~$10.8 NTM EPS as of Sep 2027) sits slightly below spot: earnings growth of ~10%/yr is roughly offset by expected mild multiple compression from a stretched, sentiment-driven level. Base rates: 25% realized vol, large-cap ±25-35% annual range; I used a lognormal centered at a ~$348 median (about +2%, small positive drift from EPS growth less de-rating) with sigma ~0.26 and slightly fattened left tail for margin/legal/derating risks (stock sits at a 52-week high after +35%, where multiple is the main swing factor). Scenario-weighted mean ~$349 (bear 255 @22%, base 350 @55%, bull 435 @23%). P(>=341) ~0.53; P(>=409, +20%) ~0.26; P(<239, -30%) ~0.095.
